description: This file contains functions and variables for rendering an evaluation graph on a chess analysis webpage, including drawing bars, handling mouse interactions, and displaying icons and tooltips.

methods.name: drawEvaluationGraph
methods.description: Asynchronously renders the evaluation graph on a canvas, including bars, midline, icons, and tooltips, and sets up event listeners for interaction.

methods.name: drawCursor
methods.description: Loads and draws a crosshair cursor image at the current mouse position.

methods.name: getMovedPlayerByPosition
methods.description: Determines which player moved based on a FEN string.

methods.name: getMovedPieceByPosition
methods.description: Identifies the piece moved based on a SAN move string.

methods.name: getSemiTransparentColor
methods.description: Converts a hex color to an RGBA string with specified opacity.
